tei:div.tei:p: (399)/phur srung mchod pa la/ sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa rgya cher bshams te/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal bcas/ bh+yo/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs// nam gyi srod kyi dam can ma// lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma// de la lcags kyi mi mos zhon// phyag na lcags phur dgra la 'debs// spyang gdong dmar nag dgra la rngams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// bh+yoḥ nam ni srod kyi dam can ma// gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad ma// de la gser gyi mi mos zhon// ral pa sprug pa'i skra gseb nas// sdom dang sdig pa char du 'bebs// 'phar gdong ser nag dgra la rngams// mchod sbyin gtor ma= /dgra bgegs = /bh+yo// nam gyi srod kyi dam can ma// zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum ma// de la zangs kyi mi mos zhon// g.yas pa'i rdo rjes ri rab bsnyil// g.yon pa zangs kyi phur pa 'dril// wa gdong dmar nag dgra la rngams// mchod sbyin = /dgra bgegs = /bh+yo/ nam gyi srod kyi pho nya mo// lcags kyi khyi mo ral pa can// de la zhon pa'i pho nya mo// mthing gi mi mo ral pa can// mthing gi phur pas dgra bgegs sgrol// khyi gdong dmar nag dgra la rngams// mchod sbyin = /dgra bgegs = /hūm̐/ bdag (400)nyid chen mo'i dus la babs// nam gyi gung gi dam can ma// dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti// mu le lding gi mtsho bdag mo// chibs su dril rta rkang gsum chibs// phyag g.yas me long sbrul zhags thogs// g.yon pas kha ṭ+wām̐ phur pa thogs// 'du ba rnams bzhi'i nad bdag mo// 'dir byon mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ rak+ta'i mtsho la skur bzhengs pa// nam gyi gung gi dam can ma// dpal ldan lha mo re ma tri// khrag skam lcags kyu phur pa thogs// bal nad lo brgan nad bdag mo// 'dir byon= /dgra bgegs bla tshe dbang du sdus// hūm̐/

nam gi gung gi dam can ma// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dza/ rgyas pa'i sku mdog gser nag la// gcod byed gser gyi zor ba bsnams// mkhris pa sha yi nad bdag mo// mchod sbyin= /dgra la rims nad dal yams phob// hūm̐/ nam ni gung gi dam can ma/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzu// rnga mong sngo nag chibs su chibs// khram shing gru gu phur pa bsnams// pho slog lhog rgal nad bdag mo// mchod sbyin= /dgra bgegs= /bh+yo/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs// nam gyi tho rang dam can ma// rgya gar bal po'i sa mtshams na// chu mig byang (401)chub bdud rtsi'i chu// dgun yang me tog skye ba'i sar// tshab nad kyi bdag mo bzhi// mthu stobs che bas so sor bzhag /bal yul ya byin sa shed na// mar khu'i mtsho mo mer ba na// rdo rje ya byin dbang mo che// chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs// phyag gnyis bdud zhags phur bu brdig /jo mo ya byin mthun mo che// blon mo nag mo 'khor bcas kyi// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa bzhes// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// bh+yo/ sa bdag chen mo'i dus= nam gyi tho reng dam can ma// yul ni tsha ba rong gi gnas// sbrang rtsi'i mtsho mo mer ba na// rdo rje de byin rtsal mo che// me lce dgu phreng sku yi rgyan// gza' rta ser po chibs su chibs// gser zhags gser phur dgra la brdeg /jo mo de byin mthu mo che// blon mo klong dgu 'khor bcas kyi// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod gtor bzhes// bcol ba'i phrin las= /bh+yo/ sa bdag chen mo'i= /nam gyi tho rang dam can ma// mang yul se byin gting shod na// khrag zhag mtsho mo mer ba na// rdo rje bswe byin 'phrul mo che// ri dwags rgyal po bse la chibs// btsan zhags ser phur dgra la brdeg /jo mos se byin mthu mo che// blon mo spyang mo 'khor bcas kyis// sha khrag = bcol ba'i = (402)bh+yo/ sa bdag chen mo'i=

/nam gyi tho ring = /snying nam 'gram gyi phar phyin na// 'o ma'i mtsho mo mer ba na// rdo rje phag byin mthu mo che// chibs su chu rta sngon mo chibs// g.yu zhags g.yu phur dgra la brdeg /jo mo bag byin mthun mo che// blon mo brang mig 'khor bcas kyi// sha khrag= /bcol ba'i= /dzaḥ rang rang rigs kyi ming po bzhi// rgyal po shel ging dkar po dang*// gdug pa lcags kyi skyes bu dang*// dmar po btsan gyi rgyal po dang*// gnod sbyin ta ki nag po 'jigs// 'khor du ging bdud btsan gyi tshogs// shan pa pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas// sha khrag= /bcol ba'i= srid pa phur par bdag sgrub kyis// khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs// mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la babs// dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod// dpal gyi bka' nyan las byed ma// ma tshogs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i// ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa la// g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas// sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi// gtsug tu bkur bar bgyi'o zhes// de skad khyod kyis zhal bzhes pas// dpal gyi bka' bzhin bdag sgrub kyis// 'dir byon sha khrag gtor ma bzhes// bcol (403)ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/

/ces mchod do// 'di ni nang gi bka' srung ste// phur pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// rtag tu mchod gsol brten byas na// 'dod dgu bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub// sa ma yā: phur srung bcu gnyis/ ming po bzhi las lcam dral bcu dragu yang sa bdag ma bzhi'i blon mo bzha dang nyi shu'o/ yang na rgyal po bzhi/ bdud bzhi/ btsan bzhi/ gnod sbyin rgyal po bzhi las blon po bzhi/ kun gyi las byed re ti nag mo bcas ging bdud nyi shu rtsa gcig tu grags pa yin no/ ces pa'ang dharmā pa ti'i thugs dam du 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis rgyud las btus pa yid ches pa'i gnas lags so/// /
